title: What is the Difference Between Me and You? Benchmarking the Quality Gap Between Human-Written and AI-Generated Code
abstract: arXiv:2609.12708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI coding assistants are becoming co-authors of production software, yet their evaluation centers on functional correctness, leaving open whether their code differs from human code in the quality dimensions dominating lifecycle cost. We compare human-written and AI-generated code at scale: 787,562 function pairs across Python, Java, and C, each human function mined from open-source repositories paired with implementations generated from its docstring by three AI assistants (OpenAI GPT models, DeepSeek-Coder, Qwen2.5-Coder). We characterize structural complexity and statistical naturalness, and map static-analysis findings onto Orthogonal Defect Classification for defects and the Common Weakness Enumeration for vulnerabilities, making authors and languages directly comparable. translated_title: 我与你有何不同？对人类编写代码与AI生成代码之间质量差距的基准测试
translated_abstract: AI编程助手正在成为生产软件的共同作者，然而目前对它们的评估主要集中于功能正确性，这使得一个问题悬而未决：它们的代码在主导软件生命周期成本的质量维度上是否与人类代码存在差异。我们大规模地比较了人类编写的代码与AI生成的代码：涵盖Python、Java和C三种语言的787,562个函数对，其中每个人类函数都从开源仓库中挖掘出来，并与三个AI助手（OpenAI GPT模型、DeepSeek-Coder、Qwen2.5-Coder）根据其文档字符串生成的实现进行配对。我们刻画了结构复杂性与统计自然性，并将静态分析发现映射到用于缺陷分析的正交缺陷分类（ODC）框架和用于漏洞分析的通用缺陷列举（CWE）框架，使不同作者和不同语言之间可以直接比较。研究结果表明，AI生成的代码在结构上是被压缩的，在风格上是模板化的：其规模和分支数量大约只有人类代码的一半，并在风格层面与人类代码形成明显分离的聚类。
tldr: 该研究构建了包含787,562个人类-AI函数对的大规模基准，发现AI生成的代码比人类代码结构上更压缩（规模和分支约为一半）、风格上更模板化，并通过ODC缺陷分类和CWE漏洞分类框架实现了人类代码与AI代码质量差异的系统性量化比较。
en_tdlr: This study builds a large-scale benchmark of 787,562 human-AI function pairs across Python, Java, and C, revealing that AI-generated code is structurally compressed (roughly half the size and branching) and stylistically templated compared to human code, with systematic quality differences quantified through ODC defect classification and CWE vulnerability mapping.
